cited_evidence: Job 2 input needs include n06-r01 with demand_score 9, source_id s01, source_weight 5 and analogous provenance fields for all records.
Job 2 output coverage entries contain record_id and need but omit demand_score, source_id, and source_weight.
Job 2 output priorities entries omit demand_score, source_id, and source_weight and set upstream_rank to 0 for every record.
Behavioural criteria require preserving record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, source_weight, deterministic source provenance identities, weights, and demand-descending rank order.
initial_receipt.explanation: Job 2 received complete demand records with demand_score, source_id, and source_weight, but its observed coverage and priorities outputs preserve only record_id and need plus coverage fields. This violates the requirement to select records while preserving record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight, and to preserve deterministic source provenance identities and weights. The priorities also report upstream_rank as 0 for every record instead of preserving the supplied provenance/rank information. No function-level evidence is supplied, so the responsible function cannot be localized.
